<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!-- Cretli managed autostart v1 -->
<!DOCTYPE plist PUBLIC "-//Apple//DTD PLIST 1.0//EN" "http://www.apple.com/DTDs/PropertyList-1.0.dtd">
<plist version="1.0"><dict>
<key>Label</key><string>com.cretli.supervisor</string>
<key>ProgramArguments</key><array><string>/home/user/node install/bin/node</string><string>/home/user/my app/scripts/cretli-supervisor.mjs</string></array>
<key>WorkingDirectory</key><string>/home/user/my app</string>
<key>EnvironmentVariables</key><dict><key>PATH</key><string>/home/user/node install/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin</string></dict>
<key>KeepAlive</key><true/><key>RunAtLoad</key><true/>
</dict></plist>
activation: Activation at next boot/login; use --apply --start to start explicitly.
